spans.s:
Ilvala
------------------------------------------
One of the exploits of the great sage अगस्त्य was his destroying the demons इल्वल and वातापि. They were the sons of the demoness Siṁhikā.
Once इल्वल approached a ब्राह्मण sage with the request that he be blessed with a son equal to इन्द्र. The sage rejected it. Since then इल्वल started hating and killing the ब्राह्मणस्, with the help of his younger brother वातापि.
The strategy adopted by इल्वल was to convert वातापि by his magical powers, into a goat, cut it and prepare a meal out of it and then serve it to a ब्राह्मण specially invited for dinner. After the dinner he would call वातापि to come out. And, वातापि would emerge in his original form tearing the ब्राह्मण apart, in the process. The brothers had thus killed many ब्राह्मणस्.
When इल्वल tried the same trick on the sage अगस्त्य, he quietly uttered the words, ‘vātāpi jīrṇo bhava’ (‘O वातापि, get digested!’) and the demon was destroyed. इल्वल too was burnt to ashes by अगस्त्य’s fierce look.
See also AGASTYA.
